uutiset.t: Maybank Reviews Exposure as US Chip Curbs Hit
uutiset.s: Maybank Investment Bank Group CEO Michael Oh-Lau tells Haslinda Amin the lender is reviewing its portfolio as new US chip restrictions prompt greater scrutiny of data-center clients and their financing needs. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Soy Oil Hits Nine-Month Low as Strong Meal Demand Boosts Crush
uutiset.s: Soybean oil prices fell to their lowest since February as high demand for meal boosted crushing and oil supplies, while weakening crude added pressure ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday in the US.

uutiset.t: Kochugovindan: Tech Volatility Is Here to Stay
uutiset.s: Aberdeen Investments Senior Research Economist Sree Kochugovindan says the AI trade faces further downside risks as investors scrutinize valuations, earnings potential and returns on investment. uutiset.t: Global Rotation on AI Fears Lifts Indian Stocks to Top Spot
uutiset.s: Indian stocks surged, extending their world-beating November rally as renewed selling in global artificial intelligence names bolstered a rotation toward markets with limited exposure to the theme.

uutiset.t: Malaysia Government Likely to Serve Full Term, Anwar Aide Says
uutiset.s: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s government is likely to serve until the end of its term despite recent speculation over an early election, according to his senior political adviser Zafrul Aziz.

uutiset.t: Maybank Reviews Portfolio as Chip Curbs Hit Data Centers
uutiset.s: Malaysia’s largest bank is reviewing its portfolio for potential exposure to the latest US chip curbs, as it assesses how the restrictions could affect data center clients and their funding needs.

uutiset.t: Xi Probes Shanghai Boss, Widening Political Shakeup
uutiset.s: China has opened an investigation into Chen Jining, a member of the country's elite Politburo and the party chief of Shanghai, for suspected serious violations of law and discipline. Bloomberg Economics' Neil Thomas has the context. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Dangote Refinery Set to Become Africa’s Biggest Listed Company
uutiset.s: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE will rank as the biggest company with a primary listing in Africa once it makes its trading debut in Lagos, far exceeding the size of the next-largest business on the continent.

uutiset.t: Metals Mixed After Major Selloff as Traders Await US Inflation
uutiset.s: Copper ticked higher and aluminum steadied after a major selloff across metals on Tuesday, as traders awaited US inflation data that will feed into the Federal Reserve’s next decision on interest rates.

uutiset.t: Japan’s 40-Year Bond Sale Draws Weaker Demand on Risk Off Mood
uutiset.s: Japan’s 40-year government bond auction on Wednesday drew weaker demand as global risk-off sentiment weighed on investor appetite.

uutiset.t: Starbucks Is Said to Engage Banks for Sale of Japan Business
uutiset.s: Starbucks Corp. has tapped advisers to prepare for a potential sale of its Japan business for several billion dollars, according to people familiar with the matter.
